newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ka Wah Bank seen issuing US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Ka Wah Bank seen issuing US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Ka Wah Bank is seen planning to issue a US$50 million floating rate certificates of deposit (FRCD) issue, bankers said on Thursday.
The issue will carry a maturity of five years with a put and a call option in year three.
HSBC Markets and Bayerische Landesbank are tipped to be close to a mandate, bankers said.
Ka Wah completed a US$88 million FRCD issue last July. The five-year facility had a put option in year three and paid 45 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
